<!-- A row of a file tree: a folder with a disclosure chevron, or a file. The glyphs are Lucide. -->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import { variants } from "../utils";

  /** FileTreeItem: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
  export const fileTreeItemVariants = variants({
    base: "flex h-6 w-full items-center gap-4 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground data-[state=selected]:bg-muted",
    variants: {
      kind: {
        folder: "",
        file: "px-8",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { kind: "file" },
  });

  export type FileTreeItemProps = {
    kind?: "folder" | "file";
    label: string;
    selected?: boolean;
    expanded?: boolean;
    class?: string;
    onclick?: () => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    kind = "file",
    label,
    selected = false,
    expanded = false,
    class: className,
    onclick,
  }: FileTreeItemProps = $props();
</script>

<ButtonPlain
  type="button"
  role="treeitem"
  class={cn(fileTreeItemVariants({ kind: kind }), className)}
  aria-selected={selected}
  tabindex={(selected ? 0 : -1)}
  aria-expanded={(((kind as string) === "folder") ? expanded : undefined)}
  data-slot="file-tree-item"
  data-kind={kind}
  data-state={(selected ? "selected" : "default")}
  onclick={() => onclick?.()}
>
  {#if ((kind as string) === "folder")}
    <LucideIcon name={(expanded ? "chevron-down" : "chevron-right")} size={16} />
    <LucideIcon name="folder-open" size={16} />
  {:else}
    <LucideIcon name="file" size={16} />
  {/if}
  <Inline class="whitespace-nowrap" data-slot="file-tree-label">
    {label}
  </Inline>
</ButtonPlain>
